root_idea.summary: The root centers on drawing something toward oneself through speech or sound: calling, summoning, asking, or inviting.
root_idea.development: From this central idea develop supplication and invocation, calling people toward a way, claims and asserted affiliation, reciprocal calling and assembly, and figurative senses of attraction, inducement, or successive collapse.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Definite and inflected active-participle realizations of the same caller noun are presented under the normalized citation form دَاعٍ.

senses.definition: To call, summon, or invite someone or a group; to call people toward a way or course.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be a person, group, or course of action; the construction with إِلَى expresses calling or inviting toward something.

senses.definition: To pray to, supplicate, petition, or invoke God, seeking a benefit or relief.
senses.usage_conditions: This includes humble petition and calling upon God in hardship; لِ may introduce a prayer for someone, while عَلَى may introduce an imprecation against someone.

senses.definition: To call upon someone or something for aid or support.
senses.usage_conditions: In this use the object is summoned as an aid or witness, as in calling helpers to one's assistance.

senses.definition: To call out for, or utter a cry concerning, a named thing or outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may express a lament or a cry for a specified fate, including calling for ruin or destruction; this is distinct from ordinary interpersonal summoning.

senses.definition: To call or draw someone away, with the resulting sense of bringing punishment, destruction, or an evil event upon him.
senses.usage_conditions: This figurative Quran-attested use is interpreted in more than one closely related way: drawing away, bringing to punishment, or destroying.

senses.definition: To claim, assert, or maintain that something belongs to oneself, is true, or is due to oneself; to demand it as a claim.
senses.usage_conditions: The claim may be true or false and may be directed against another person or concern a thing asserted as one's own.

senses.definition: To desire, request, or seek something, especially to demand or wish for its arrival.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passages where the form is explained in this sense, the desired thing may be something sought or hastened; an alternate interpretation at 67:27 takes the wording as denial or disbelief rather than desire.

senses.definition: A caller, summoner, or inviter; especially one who calls people toward a way or religion.
senses.usage_conditions: The participle can designate a caller generally or one who summons others to a religious or moral course.

senses.definition: A claim, assertion, demand, or plea concerning something.
senses.usage_conditions: The word may denote a claim whether true or false, including a demand or case brought forward.

senses.definition: A prayer, call, plea, or cry.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage the noun can denote a supplication or a cry uttered by people in distress, as well as a concluding call or prayer.

senses.definition: A call, invocation, supplication, or invitation.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to the act or occasion of calling upon God, calling someone, or inviting people toward a matter.
The lexical branch of دعوة associated with دعوى denotes an assertion of a relation or of a matter belonging to someone; the Quranic context may render it as a claim.

senses.definition: Prayer, supplication, or invocation addressed to God.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may denote a petition, plea, or invocation; with لِ it can express a blessing or prayer for good, and with عَلَى an imprecation.

senses.definition: A call, cry, or act of calling out.
senses.usage_conditions: This includes a cry or call that may be heard by others, including an urgent call for help or a call whose force is illustrated by the cry of someone unable to hear or respond.

senses.definition: Addressing or calling someone by name.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction دعاء الرسول, the noun concerns the manner of addressing the Messenger, contrasted with ordinary mutual calling by name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek, desire, ask for, or demand something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general Classical use of the verb, including requesting that an object be brought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To request or require that a book, writing, or other thing be brought; to desire something on perceiving it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction دَعَا بِ expresses requesting or requiring the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To need, require, or be in need of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing, condition, or circumstance that calls for repair, replacement, or provision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invite people to eat or to a meal at one's home.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the conventional invitation-to-food use of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw, attract, induce, lead, or drive someone toward an action or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject may be an event, circumstance, or object that causes someone to seek or move toward something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lament, mourn, or call upon a dead person while praising or enumerating his qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This idiom denotes wailing for or deploring the dead rather than ordinary summoning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To claim a relationship or lineage, especially to claim someone as one's father or son when the relationship is not biological.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The claim may be made by either party and may be true or false; in warfare it can include asserting one's own lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to assert or claim a sonship or family relationship to a person who is not his father.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a causative lineage-claim construction, distinct from making the claim oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave some milk in the udder so that it draws or attracts the milk that follows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is used of retaining a remainder rather than exhausting the udder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To propose an enigma or riddle to someone, or contend with him by doing so.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal or competitive construction concerns riddling and solving enigmas.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask a person for something repeatedly or excessively until wearying him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized Form III use associated with persistent asking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull down or demolish a wall from its sides or foundations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes collective action against a wall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The trilling, modulating, or prolonging of a woman's voice while wailing for the dead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized form of lamentation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call, summon, or convoke one another; hence to gather, league together, or advance collectively against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal construction may concern assembling for war, mutual aid, or an enemy's advance from every side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To crack, break apart, collapse, or deteriorate successively; of a building, walls, a sandhill, clouds, or emaciated camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The imagery involves one part drawing another after it, whether by progressive collapse, dispersal, or deterioration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call one another by surnames or nicknames.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal construction concerns mutual forms of address.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To test or challenge one another with riddles or enigmas.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form VI reciprocal counterpart of proposing an enigma.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compete with one another in discourse, especially in eloquence and refined speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression presents the competitors as challenging one another in verbal skill.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call people together collectively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive Form VI construction has a plural subject jointly performing the calling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To answer, reply, respond, or assent when called.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may describe readiness to respond to a summons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call for, demand, require, or invite a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X verb is a derived request or summons and is distinct from the pointer-only citation of its entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act or occurrence of prayer or imprecation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Here دَعْوَة is a verbal noun or simple substantive denoting one instance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The distance covered by a man's or dog's call; also precedence or priority in receiving something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can function as a measure of calling distance or in expressions of priority in distribution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The call to prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the conventional religious office or act of summoning people to prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A call or invitation to Islam or to the declaration of faith.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may denote an invitation to a religion or specifically to affirm God's unity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An invitation to food, drink, a repast, feast, or banquet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In this sense the noun can denote either the invitation or the meal occasion to which one is invited.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A confederation or alliance for mutual aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes the group with which a person is allied or affiliated for assistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Kindred, relationship, or brotherhood among a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the relationship sense of the noun, distinct from a claim asserting such a relationship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: No one present or no person in a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This rare adjective is used only in negative sentences and is explained as there being no one who calls out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adoration, worship, or religious service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical extension of supplication to religious worship generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Faith or belief, especially belief in God, revelation, and the messengers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning is reported as an exegetical and theological usage rather than the ordinary sense of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calling or crying for aid or succour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized cry for assistance, broader than a formal prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person invited to a repast or meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the invited guest in this specialized usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An adopted son or a person claimed as a son by someone who is not his biological father.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can describe either the claimant or the person claimed, according to the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose origin, lineage, or parentage is suspected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning concerns doubtful or questioned parentage and is distinct from the act of claiming relationship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who prays, supplicates, or calls often or excessively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensive form expresses frequent or repeated performance of the underlying action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forefinger, regarded as the finger with which one calls or beckons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an epithet whose substantive meaning has predominated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A punisher.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized Classical meaning of the caller noun, distinct from ordinary summoning or invitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The remainder of milk left in the udder to draw or attract what follows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression advises not exhausting the milk completely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A means, cause, or motive that draws or induces an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This figurative noun denotes an inducement or motivating cause.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cry of horsemen in battle used to call for aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is figurative from the calling function of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anxieties or troubling impulses of the breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative plural expression for inner concerns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vicissitudes or changes of fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression figuratively presents events as causes that draw circumstances onward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enigma or riddle, including one composed in verse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun belongs to the lexical branch of challenging or drawing out an answer through a riddle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Causes of glory, memorable qualities, or generous achievements, especially in war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural occurs in the expression pairing means of attaining elevation with causes for honorable renown.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Property or a matter claimed by a claimant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related construction مُدَّعًى بِهِ denotes the thing claimed, while مُدَّعًى عَلَيْهِ denotes the person against whom the claim is made.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A defendant or person against whom a property claim or lawsuit is brought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a legal specialization of the passive-derived expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A claimant or plaintiff in a property matter or lawsuit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle denotes the person making the claim.

cautions: The Form VIII Quranic passages admit closely related interpretive alternatives between claiming, desiring or demanding, and in one passage denying or disbelieving.

The figurative Form I use associated with calling away or destruction has divergent Classical explanations; the artifact preserves the shared draw-away/punitive branch without treating one interpretation as certain.
